items.title: 向量数据库要被取代？DynamoDB 开始原生支持 AI 搜索
items.raw_excerpt: Amazon DynamoDB 最近推出了原生向量搜索 ，允许开发者将嵌入向量与应用数据存储在一起，并直接在 DynamoDB 中运行近似最近邻查询，无需使用单独的向量数据库。该功能支持带过滤条件的相似度搜索，以及面向语义搜索工作负载的可配置向量索引。

title_i18n.zh: 向量数据库要被取代？DynamoDB 开始原生支持 AI 搜索
title_i18n.en: Will vector databases be replaced? DynamoDB begins native support for AI search.
title_i18n.es: ¿Van a ser sustituidas las bases de datos vectoriales? DynamoDB comienza a admitir de forma nativa la búsqueda con IA

excerpt_i18n.zh: Amazon DynamoDB 最近推出了原生向量搜索 ，允许开发者将嵌入向量与应用数据存储在一起，并直接在 DynamoDB 中运行近似最近邻查询，无需使用单独的向量数据库。该功能支持带过滤条件的相似度搜索，以及面向语义搜索工作负载的可配置向量索引。
excerpt_i18n.en: Amazon DynamoDB recently launched native vector search, allowing developers to store embedding vectors alongside application data and run approximate nearest neighbor queries directly in DynamoDB without needing a separate vector database. This feature supports similarity search with filtering conditions and configurable vector indexes for semantic search workloads.
excerpt_i18n.es: Amazon DynamoDB ha lanzado recientemente la búsqueda vectorial nativa, lo que permite a los desarrolladores almacenar vectores de incrustación junto con los datos de la aplicación y ejecutar consultas de vecinos más cercanos aproximados directamente en DynamoDB, sin necesidad de usar una base de datos vectorial independiente. Esta función admite búsqueda por similitud con condiciones de filtrado, así como índices vectoriales configurables para cargas de trabajo de búsqueda semántica.

items.title: Why can AI generate Super Mario but not a wedge ramp for my robot vacuum?
items.raw_excerpt: I've been puzzled by something: AI generation can produce an elaborate figurine, a cartoon character, even a convincing Super Mario — yet it can't reliably make a simple wedge ramp so my robot vacuum can climb a step. For context: I bought a Bambu P2S but can't model. I tried the "describe it and get a model" AIs — the output is unusable, you can't adjust it, it's never quite what I meant. I tried having an agent write Python to build geometry directly — it tops out at simple primitives. What finally worked: geometric decomposition. I break a complex part into ordered, grouped steps, describe each as a small spec, and let an agent execute them in Blender (via blender-mcp). That process turned out to abstract into a small engine — the key insight being it converts the 3D spatial reasoning L

title_i18n.en: Why can AI generate Super Mario but not a wedge ramp for my robot vacuum?
title_i18n.zh: 为什么AI能生成超级马里奥，却做不出我家扫地机用的坡道楔块？
title_i18n.es: ¿Por qué la IA puede generar Super Mario pero no una rampa en cuña para mi aspirador robot?

excerpt_i18n.en: I've been puzzled by something: AI generation can produce an elaborate figurine, a cartoon character, even a convincing Super Mario — yet it can't reliably make a simple wedge ramp so my robot vacuum can climb a step.
